name: Alt: most desktop, four sit/stand desks (204 3/4") and no guest bed
notes:
Alternative (F-41): the most desktop. The personal run, the work desk and a second MITTZON as a spare desk give 204 3/4" of sit/stand desk. Gives up the guest bed (F-62 allows a daybed only if small; here there is none) and floor storage.
desk-1 and desk-2: the personal run on the right wall, rot 90, x 74.5-106, y 12-114.4; F-33 6" from the heater face; F-31 7.6" above the door's swing (assumed-position:door); F-35 47" to the work desk and 43" to the spare desk · four 32" screens as in a.
desk-3 TRAVSPORT: left wall, rot 270, x 0-27.5, y 12-59.25, the work station; F-33 6" from the heater face; F-35 47" to desk-1 · fits.
desk-4 MITTZON 55 1/8x31 1/2, the spare desk (printer, papers, a second laptop, a second person standing): left wall, rot 270, x 0-31.5, y 59.25-114.4; F-31 3.6" above the wardrobe's left swing (assumed-position:closet); F-35 43" to desk-2, over the 42" where someone passes · fits.
chair-1 FLINTAN: the run's center, x 46-74, y 50-78 · fits. chair-2 FLINTAN: the work desk, x 28-56, y 21.6-49.6, rolled to the spare desk when it is needed; a third chair parked there would leave a 14" walkway (F-30) · fits.
lamp-1 TÅGARP: bottom-left corner, x 0.5-9.5, y 142-151, left of the wardrobe's swing (assumed-position:closet) · fits. plant-1 FEJKA: x 1-8.5, y 116-123.5, left of the wardrobe's swing · fits.
rug-1 LOHALS (rug layer): x 25-77, y 20-97 under both chairs. rug-2 KOLON (rug layer): x 35.1-74.5, y 40.4-87.6 under chair-1.
storage-2 BESTÅ shelf unit with doors 47 1/4x16 1/2x15 (top, F-63): hung on the left wall above the work desk, x 0-16.5, y 12-59.25, its underside about 70" up so it clears the work monitor with the desk at full height (46 1/8"), its top about 85", under any 8' ceiling; two suspension rails. art-1 PJÄTTERYD 3-pack (top): the three canvases in a row over the spare desk's door end and the corner, y 76-144, 54-76" up, clear of the spare desk at 49 5/8". lamp-2 RÖDFLIK (top): the work desk's door end. lamp-3 RÖDFLIK (top): the spare desk's window end.
Extras: the blinds, two HUANUO arms, three cable trays (both run desks and the spare desk), the FREIVID mat, the ELLOVEN, two suspension rails, the throw over chair-1.
Not placed: any guest bed (a guest gets an air mattress on the rug or the living room), the low BESTÅ (no free floor wall), the 2026-10-22 MICKE, ALEX, BILLY and HEMNES (see a).
Prices: the new pieces as of 2026-10-23; the reused ones (FLINTAN, TÅGARP, RÖDFLIK, FEJKA, LOHALS, PJÄTTERYD, HOPPVALS, FÖRSÄSONG, ELLOVEN, bedding and textiles) as of 2026-10-22, price-stale (F-02).
